<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

s08's routing table is only useful while it is true, and today holdings outlive their work: merged PRs keep their reviewer, security, performance and coder holdings until someone releases them one by one. This plan makes `pij delivered` release them, adds release --batch, gives lineage add a human summary, and has the writer keep ROUTES.md current. Starts after #149 (plan 212, release renderer and window rule) and #144 (plan 209, lineage --batch) merge. One coder.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Merge releases a PR's holdings, release takes --batch, lineage add prints a human line, and ROUTES.md stays true without a manual write.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Lineage add --batch (F67, plan 209).
- Ageing holdings out by time: only merge ends them here.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

F70 (prime, 22:54 after #130 merged): the routes table listed coder holdings for merged plans (199, 201, 207, 208, 213) and 11 reviewer/<pr> holdings for merged PRs; pm-001 released 12 by hand. Merge is the natural end of those holdings, and s08's table is only useful while it is true. F71 (pm-001): releasing those 12 took 12 calls and 12 commits; assign has --batch (plan 208), release does not. F66 (pm-001, lineage dogfood): lineage add through the shim printed the raw JSON receipt. F72 (prime, 23:14): ROUTES.md needs `routes --write`, though the writer already commits on every assign and release. F67 (lineage add --batch) is in #144 (plan 209), not here. Seams: pij delivered (plan 196), the writer and assign --batch (plan 208), release's window rule (#149, plan 212), routes (plan 202, #130).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
